sentences.en: Kozue thought the teacher's lecture was dull, boring and endless.
sentences.zh: 小佐认为老师的讲课枯燥乏味、没完没了。

sentences.en: As many as fifty students gathered to hear his lecture.
sentences.zh: 有五十多个学生来听他的演讲。

sentences.en: I ought to have attended the lecture but I didn't.
sentences.zh: 我本应该去听那个讲座的，但我没有去。
